patches.author: OpenAI Codex, adapting the repository lean URL quotation proof
patches.origin: rust-cpython/experiments/url-quote-lean-proof/{quote.rs,module.c,build.py} and the pinned Rust-for-CPython source; original build integration authored for this experiment on 2026-09-24; 2026-09-25: registered Modules/_rust_url_quote in configure SRCDIRS so out-of-tree parallel builds create its object directory, and removed the hard-coded aarch64-apple-darwin rustc target
patches.license: PSF-2.0, matching the pinned CPython fork and repository proof
patches.reason: Evaluate guarded exact-bytes URL percent quotation through a CPython-owned C extension and private no_std Rust kernel while consulting the original Python quoter and its mutable per-safe state before native dispatch.
patches.compatibility: Applies to Rust-for-CPython commit b812b4a7b9efaca46b98544a8633b7d7e454166b with Cargo.lock SHA-256 55f5f3bf547d3b9e7896a5feb6d17aa3b607610c7c21d919164f0877a8d05023; preserves the original urllib.parse fast exits and quoter fallback, permits native quotation only for exact bytes with original Python helper bindings, quoter methods, and empty per-safe cache; populated or edited caches, one-byte calls, and active trace/profile hooks use Python. A native hit leaves the private per-byte cache empty; public result and edited-cache fallback matched the pinned parser in bounded diagnostics, while private state parity remains open. Installed 3.16 and quiet-host performance qualification remain open. Builds the private kernel for Cargo's configured target (the native host when CARGO_TARGET is empty) on the macOS aarch64 and Linux x86_64 lanes with nightly-2026-09-15.
patches.reproducer: Apply to the locked archive with git apply --check, build the pinned Rust candidate, then run the 2,177 public differential cases from rust-cpython/experiments/url-quote-lean-proof/check.py adapted to compare installed candidate and control, plus python3.16 -m test test_urlparse test_urllib -j1.
